class.name: HEGoAssetSection
class.brief_description: One collapsible block of parameters in the bottom panel, for one HDA.
class.description: A node that puts several HDAs in the panel gets one of these per HDA. A node with a single HDA gets its parameters directly and no header, so the common case looks exactly as it did.

method.name: setup
method.description: Builds the section for [param operator_name], titled with [param p_asset_label].

method.name: get_container
method.description: Where this section's parameter widgets go.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens the section without reporting it, for when a script asked for it rather than the user. The panel's remembered state is the user's, and highlighting should not overwrite it.

method.name: mark_highlighted
method.description: Draws attention to the section a script highlighted.

members.member: The label the node gave this HDA. The panel remembers the open state by it.

signal.name: open_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the user opens or closes the section, so the panel can remember it.
